name: Mineral Fabrication & Machine Company Inc.
old_description: Since 1978 Mineral Fabrication has delivered quality construction and fabrication throughout the South, Midwest and Northeast. Our diverse portfolio and dynamic growth has developed through clients' sincere word of mouth about the excellence of our workmanship and the proud way in which we do business.
about: Founded in 1978, Mineral Fabrication & Machine Company Inc. has delivered construction and fabrication services from its base in Keyser, West Virginia, covering projects throughout the South, Midwest, and Northeast. The company’s core work includes building machine parts and complete machines, as well as designing and fabricating custom production machinery for other manufacturers to run high-volume lines. This dual focus on fabrication and machine building supports both one-off projects and repeat production needs. Its client list features the West Virginia Department of Transportation for public infrastructure work and industrial companies like Greer Industries, Inc., indicating a footprint in both government and heavy-industrial sectors. Management points to a reputation built on workmanship and a business style that has generated sustained word-of-mouth referrals as the driver of its long-term growth.
